map.IPSS-MF 与 DIPSS 怎么选？: How to choose IPSS-MF versus DIPSS?
map.IPSS-MF 用于初诊（含年龄项），DIPSS/DIPSS-plus 更适合已: IPSS-MF is for initial diagnosis (includes age); DIPSS/DIPSS-plus better fit established cases needing dynamic re-stratification (adding platelet, transfusion dependence, karyotype); clinically both are often reported.
